svg.text: Notice the staircase: each strengthening step turns one more red cell green.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: * Snapshot Isolation prevents phantoms for read-only queries but NOT for write skew.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: Many engines marketed as "snapshot isolation" still allow Write Skew. Only Serializable closes it.
